vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the cooling-off period above; waiting 5 days on a known CVE is the wrong trade.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate only bumps direct dependencies, so refresh the whole lockfile weekly to pick up transitive fixes.

packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates straight to the branch when CI is green, so a passing bump makes no noise and Renovate only opens a PR when one fails. Both workflows trigger on pushes to renovate/** so these branches actually get checked -- do not narrow those triggers without moving this back to automergeType 'pr'.
Stay on TypeScript 6: typescript-eslint refuses to load against TS 7.0 (see typescript-eslint issue 10940, which targets TS 7.1). Drop this rule once typescript-eslint supports TS 7.

Keep @types/node on the major that matches the runtime. Node 24 is pinned in four places that must move together: .nvmrc, the engines field in package.json, and the node-version matrix in both ci.yml and lint.yml.
